subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw support a provenance-preserving immutable-container official plugin root/install-record contract for external channel plugins, and where should that record live relative to mounted runtime state?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the repair decides which external plugin code receives trusted host-managed keyed state and ingress capabilities, so automation should not choose the trust boundary or storage contract.

options.title: Approve Immutable Official Plugin Root
options.body: Keep raw load paths untrusted, but add a documented build-time install/provenance root that survives mounted runtime config/state and is checked against official package identity.

options.title: Document Mounted-Home Requirement Only
options.body: Keep the current model and document that trusted official plugins must be installed into the same mounted OpenClaw home used by the runtime container.

options.title: Defer To Broader Trust Policy
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers decide the combined policy for ClawHub, self-hosted/load-path, workspace-origin, and community keyed-state access.

recommendation.title: Approve Immutable Official Plugin Root
recommendation.body: Keep raw load paths untrusted, but add a documented build-time install/provenance root that survives mounted runtime config/state and is checked against official package identity.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the issue and already gave the clearest maintainer-side trust-model guidance in the thread.
